blurb: Six aboard: a driver, a front passenger, two seated behind them and two standing in the back row, all five riders shooting their own weapons

notes.model: The owner's Tactical Off-Road Beast and its Rugged Off-Road Tire (Meshy Community, content/guns.json): a long tube-frame buggy with a roof gun, its hubs bare, so the tires go on at its hubs at their own size and it rides on them. It was the Buggy until 2026-11-11 and is again from 2026-11-13 (owner: "bring back the other buggy (with the separated wheel), to sit 6 (2 stand up in back seats/row)"); the sci-fi buggy that replaced it is now the Supply Buggy (content/vehicles/supply_buggy.json).
notes.half: Fitted across the tires (as the Gun Jeep's and Troop Truck's): the body is 1.8 m wide and 4.4 m long; the tires (0.42 m radius, 0.33 m wide: the tire model's own size, 0.41 by 0.32 m, a touch larger so each hub, 0.42 m up, has its tire on the ground) stand out to 1.17 m either side and 2.28 m behind the middle (the rear hubs at z -1.86). 1.48 m tall on 0.24 m of ride height (the standing riders' shoulders stand above it).
notes.seats: Measured on the model (slices of its triangles, 2026-11-13): two rows of cushions 0.8 m up, 0.32 m either side of the middle (front row z 0.3, back row z -0.45; the front footwell 0.18 m under the cushion, the back one 0.28 m); the wheel on the left at z 0.75. Behind the back row's backrests (z -0.6 to -0.7) a third bench, its cushion 0.72 m up from z -0.65 to -1.05, under the roof frame's open bay between the cross bar at z -0.4 and the rear hoop at z -0.95 (the roof gun runs down the middle, |x| < 0.15). The two in the back row stand on that bench either side of the gun (x ±0.3, z -0.8), their shoulders out of the open roof like the Gun Jeep's hatch gunner. The roof gun is not manned.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height, under the front roof bar (1.47 m at z 0.55), looking over the wheel and dash. Up close the driver sees an in-house cockpit instead of the body's own (client content/cockpits.ts).
notes.vehicle: The Warthog feel: soft, long-travel springs (bouncy, leans out of turns), loose at speed so it powerslides; the suspension's contact points are the hubs (`wheels`, `hub` 0.42 m).
